evidence.quote: Frank Bond served as Division Chief from 1903 to 1907.

In his letter of December 28, 1906, he wrote to John Muir regarding the location of certain Petrified Forest remains in Arizona that were outside the boundaries of the Petrified Forest National Monument.

claim: John Muir was an early advocate of preservation of wilderness in the United States.

evidence.quote: John Muir (1838 –1914) was a Scottish-born American naturalist, author, and early advocate of preservation of wilderness in the United States.
He was a Scottish-born American naturalist, author, and an advocate for the preservation of wilderness in the United States and the National Park Service.
